name: Brit 50-50 maska chaska 40g (20)
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED PALM & PALMOLEIN OIL, SUGAR, LIQUID GLUCOSE, RAISING AGENTS [503(ii), 341(ii), 500(ii) & 450(i)], BUTTER (1.2%), BLACK SALT, MILK SOLIDS, DEHYDRATED VEGETABLE (CHIVES) (1%), IODISED SALT, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE, DOUGH CONDITIONER (223) AND IMPROVERS [1101(i)& XYLANASE]. (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System) CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK AND SULPHITE. STORE IN A COOL, HYGIENIC AND DRY PLACE. TRANSFER CONTENTS TO A CLEAN AIRTIGHT CONTAINER ONCE OPENED. JURUCTRIES LTD. 5/1 A HUNGERFORD
